{{Top|leg}}
The '''maser fan''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] artillery [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] constructed from a set of [[maser]] emitters connected to a single power source. The fan was capable of spraying maser energy at a single target.
